Revisiting '71 thru' 'Genocide'
2013-12-26T00:00:25+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/revisiting-71-thru-genocide-3972

My special thanks to TDS for publishing 'Genocide', a report by renowned journalist Anthony Mascarenhas on ethnic cleansing on our soil. The atrocities done by the Pak army is beyond description. The pictorial capacity of the report draws my attention till the last word of the write-up. The killing spree of the Pak soldiers and their bragging about the catches uncover the moral bankruptcy of the so-called mighty officers. Hats off to TDS again. Swapon Biswas On e-mail
